profile.headline: Full-Stack Data Engineer | Data Analyst
profile.summary: Developer with professional experiences in Business Intelligence, data engineering, SQL development, reporting, visualization, ETL development, and big data. Strong in statistical knowledge, data analysis, and analytical skill. Passionate about data and turning information into insights.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Designed, built, and maintained tabular and multidimensional models that are compatible with Star and Snowflake schemas.
-Created and developed advanced metrics, KPIs, visualizations, and dashboards to drive business decisions and improve efficiencies.
-Migrated data and reporting solutions to the Azure cloud environment.
-Developed, designed, and optimized complex SQL queries. Strong knowledge of MDX and DAX languages.
-Performed analysis on large datasets to help answer a wide variety of business questions.
-Defined and implemented data security model across all business intelligence products including row-level security.
-Designed ETL workflows using SSIS and BTEQ scripting languages.
-Mentored and developed other engineers and provided detailed feedback on code reviews.

positions.title: Sr. Business Analyst, Customer Reporting and Analytics
positions.description: Designed and developed multi-layer metadata models using Cognos Framework Manager for ad-hoc reports, drill-down reports, slice and dice capabilities, and dashboards.  Developed analytical and operational reports and publish through Microsoft SharePoint for mass consumption. Performed data analysis on cost management, utilization management, and other client performance metrics.

positions.title: Data Mining Analyst
positions.description: Deployed predictive analytics on historical data to understand business trends and provided valuable business insights and Led a market basket analysis project to cross-sell and up-sell our compensation surveys data.  Enhanced sales and marketing functions by compiling, interpreting, and evaluating demographics, customer profiles, and purchased data to drive sales and improve customer satisfaction.
